newsitem.title: UK: Holiday-hit Euro oil products boosted by crude.
newsitem.headline: Holiday-hit Euro oil products boosted by crude.

text.p: European oil products markets were quietened by a Netherlands national holiday, but supported by stronger crude and futures prices, traders said.
Naphtha edged higher on Tuesday's crude rally but this week's European holidays clouded potential prompt deals.
Gasoline barges rose $2 due to crude oil, seasonal factors and further buying from a Scandanavian company, traders said.
Gas oil was pulled $1.50 a tonne higher by stronger futures and holding premiums. Diesel was firm on tight supplies.
High sulphur barges were talked around $80/$82 fob but no deals were seen. Low sulphur was steady.
